content.text:
DeepWiki: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository and read its AI-generated DeepWiki documentation.
By Cognition. Docs & Knowledge. Verified by mcp.tc: official server from Cognition.
Listing page: https://mcp.tc/i/deepwiki
Server URL (connect to this): https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
Access: No sign-in: add the server URL to any client that supports remote MCP servers.
DeepWiki connects your assistant to AI-generated documentation for public GitHub repositories. You can list a repository's documentation topics, read the full wiki contents, and ask questions about the codebase, with answers grounded in its wiki. It runs as a hosted remote server at https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp using streamable HTTP. A legacy SSE endpoint exists at /sse but is being deprecated. No sign-in or API key is needed for public repositories.
Tools (3): ask_wiki_question, read_wiki_contents, read_wiki_structure
Setup (call get_server with client=<id> for the full steps):
- Claude Code (claude-code): `claude mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp`
- Claude Desktop (claude-desktop): Open Customize → Connectors, click + Add, then Add custom connector, URL https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
- claude.ai (claude-ai): Add to claude.ai: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=DeepWiki&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.deepwiki.com%2Fmcp
- ChatGPT (chatgpt): see client=chatgpt
- Cursor (cursor): Add to Cursor: https://cursor.com/install-mcp?name=deepwiki&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5kZWVwd2lraS5jb20vbWNwIn0%3D
- VS Code (vscode): `code --add-mcp '{"name":"deepwiki","type":"http","url":"https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"}'`
- Devin Desktop (devin): see client=devin
- Codex (codex): `codex mcp add deepwiki --url https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp`
- Gemini CLI (gemini): `gemini mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp`
- Any client (json): see client=json

setup.label: Claude Code
steps: Run this in a terminal, in your project folder:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
```
Start Claude Code and type `/mcp`. **deepwiki** should show as connected.
setup.code: claude mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
setup.note: Add `--scope user` to make it available in every project, not just this one.

setup.label: Claude Desktop
setup.quick: Open Customize → Connectors, click + Add, then Add custom connector, URL https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
steps: Open **Customize → Connectors**, click **+ Add**, then **Add custom connector**.
Name it **DeepWiki** and paste this URL:
https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
Click **Add**. Its tools appear in the chat’s tools menu.
setup.note: Claude Desktop’s JSON config file only starts local servers. Remote servers go through Connectors, and connectors you add on claude.ai show up here too.

setup.label: claude.ai
steps: Open the connector form on claude.ai. This button fills in the name and URL for you:
Add to claude.ai: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=DeepWiki&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.deepwiki.com%2Fmcp
Check that the URL reads `https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp` and click **Add**.
Turn it on in a chat from the tools menu.
setup.note: Free plans allow one custom connector. On Team and Enterprise plans an owner adds it under **Organization settings → Connectors**.

setup.label: ChatGPT
steps: On chatgpt.com, open **Settings → Security and login** and turn on **Developer mode**.
Go to `chatgpt.com/plugins` and click **+** to create an app for a remote MCP server.
Paste `https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp` as the server URL and choose **No authentication**.
setup.note: Developer mode is available on the web for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education accounts.

setup.label: Cursor
steps: Add to Cursor: https://cursor.com/install-mcp?name=deepwiki&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5kZWVwd2lraS5jb20vbWNwIn0%3D
Or add it by hand to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` (all projects) or `.cursor/mcp.json` (this project):

setup.label: VS Code
steps: Install in VS Code: https://vscode.dev/redirect/mcp/install?name=deepwiki&config=%7B%22type%22%3A%22http%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.deepwiki.com%2Fmcp%22%7D

```bash
code --add-mcp '{"name":"deepwiki","type":"http","url":"https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"}'
```
Or commit it to the repo in `.vscode/mcp.json`:

setup.label: Devin Desktop
steps: Add it to `~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json` (macOS and Linux) or `%APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json` (Windows):
Refresh the MCP server list in Cascade.
setup.note: Devin Desktop is the new name for Windsurf. It reads `serverUrl` (or `url`) for remote servers.

setup.label: Codex
steps:
```bash
codex mcp add deepwiki --url https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
```
Or edit `~/.codex/config.toml` directly:

```toml
[mcp_servers.deepwiki]
url = "https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"
```

setup.label: Gemini CLI
steps:
```bash
gemini mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
```
setup.code: gemini mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
setup.note: This adds it to the current project. Add `-s user` to use it everywhere.

setup.label: Any client
steps: Most clients accept this shape. Some name the URL field differently: `serverUrl` in Devin Desktop, `httpUrl` in Gemini CLI’s settings file.
Zed puts servers under `context_servers` in its settings. Cline needs `"type": "streamableHttp"`, or it assumes SSE.
Client only starts local servers? Bridge it with `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp`.
